purpose: Test whether post-selection PriorityScore sizing creates enough realized edge to justify its allocation tilt, without changing selected names.

costPolicy.rule: Cost-adjusted dominance remains UNKNOWN unless the incremental cost difference between sizing rules is explicitly measured or conservatively bounded.
costPolicy.reason: Same total deployment makes linear entry notional cost similar, but exit notional, minimum commissions, odd-lot effects and slippage can differ. Do not silently set incremental cost to zero.

riskPolicy.metric: grossIncrementalPnlNTD / incrementalProjectedPlanRiskNTD when current projected risk exceeds comparator
riskPolicy.interpretation: descriptive only; no arbitrary minimum ratio is predeclared
dominanceCases: If gross sizing alpha > 0 and incremental projected risk <= 0, current sizing is weakly dominant on this horizon before unmeasured costs, but still not promotion-grade by itself.
If gross sizing alpha <= 0 and incremental projected risk > 0, current sizing is dominated on this horizon before unmeasured costs.
If both alpha and risk rise, tradeoff remains unresolved and requires cross-date risk-adjusted evidence.
If both alpha and risk fall, tradeoff remains favorable structurally but still requires robustness/cost evidence.

outcomeClock.primary: formal selection close -> D1/D3/D5 fixed-horizon returns on the same selected cohort
outcomeClock.secondary: BUY-triggered execution P&L only as an execution estimand
outcomeClock.warning: Do not replace selected-cohort sizing analysis with BUY-only outcomes; BUY triggering can induce post-selection sample bias.

requiredEvidence: same selected names across current and comparator
all eligible scan dates retained including zero/one-name dates as non-identifying cases
forbidden: infer sizing alpha from one 2026-09-18 witness
use only winners or BUY-triggered rows
treat projected stop-risk as realized loss
set incremental transaction cost to zero without evidence
pick a subjective required PnL-per-risk threshold after seeing data

witnessIdentity.use: algebra witness only; no outcome was read
